subject: Error in U.all %*% Gamma.all : non-conformable arguments

messages.author: 2de62e49d7da237b
messages.subject: Error in U.all %*% Gamma.all : non-conformable arguments
parts:
Hi,
I am working on a project that involves ordinal data. When I was inspecting the warning messages that I received from
e.g.,
> fit3 <- cfa(m3,                # use Model 3
+             df,                # use dataset
+             ordered=TRUE,      # treat data as ordinal
+             estimator="ULSMV") # use ULSMV as estimator
Warning message:
In lav_model_vcov(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavsamplestats = lavsamplestats,  :
  lavaan WARNING:
    The variance-covariance matrix of the estimated parameters (vcov)
    does not appear to be positive definite! The smallest eigenvalue
    (= -3.825725e-17) is smaller than zero. This may be a symptom that
    the model is not identified.

I tried to replace [estimator="ULSMV"] by [estimator="ULS", test="scaled.shifted"] to see if the warning occurs only when robust s.e. are computed (I am pretty sure that's the case but I want to confirm). An error message appeared.

> fit3 <- cfa(m3,                # use Model 3
+             df,                # use dataset
+             ordered=TRUE,      # treat data as ordinal
+             estimator="ULS",
+             test="scaled.shifted") # use ULSMV as estimator
Error in U.all %*% Gamma.all : non-conformable arguments

I also tried to use [debug=TRUE] to understand what's happening - but no luck. Could someone help?

  convergence status (0=ok):  0
  nlminb message says:  relative convergence (4)
  number of iterations:  37
  number of function evaluations [objective, gradient]:  48 38
lavoptim    ... done.
lavimplied  ... done.
lavloglik   ... done.
computing VCOV for      se = standard ... done.
computing TEST for test(s) = standard scaled.shifted ...Error in U.all %*% Gamma.all : non-conformable arguments

Thank you very much.
Gabriel
